nth.description: 0-based index of the match to use, applied after pageAlias, frame and container scoping. The runner takes that one match and does not reject ambiguity; an index past the last match never attaches (assertion_timeout). Use it only when the target is genuinely the nth item of a list, never to paper over an ambiguous locator. Count predicates refuse a locator with nth.

resource.description: Declares the resource this request creates so a cleanup entry can delete it. Needs both handle and ownerProof, and a top-level cleanup entry whose resourceRef is this step's id; otherwise the cleanup never runs (cleanup_never_runs)

handle.description: JSON pointer to the new resource's id in this request's response

ownerProof.description: JSON pointer to a response field proving the run's account owns the resource (creator, user or tenant id)
